back.en: Same difference d between consecutive terms
back.bm: Beza d yang sama antara sebutan berturutan

back.en: Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d] = n/2 (a + l), l = last term
back.bm: Sₙ = n/2 [2a + (n − 1)d] = n/2 (a + l), l = sebutan terakhir

back.en: Same ratio r between consecutive terms
back.bm: Nisbah r yang sama antara sebutan berturutan

back.en: Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1)/(r − 1) for r > 1; a(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r) for r < 1
back.bm: Sₙ = a(rⁿ − 1)/(r − 1) bagi r > 1; a(1 − rⁿ)/(1 − r) bagi r < 1

back.en: S∞ = a/(1 − r), only when −1 < r < 1
back.bm: S∞ = a/(1 − r), hanya apabila −1 < r < 1

back.en: Write as a GP and use S∞, e.g. 0.333… = 0.3/(1 − 0.1) = 1/3
back.bm: Tulis sebagai JG dan guna S∞, cth. 0.333… = 0.3/(1 − 0.1) = 1/3

back.en: Use logarithms when n is in the index
back.bm: Guna logaritma apabila n dalam indeks
